name: Creamy Tuscan Pork Chops
nutrition_note: Source publishes 520 cal, 45g protein, 3g NET carbs per serving (total carbs low - cream/spinach/sun-dried tomato). Structurally low-carb: meat + cream + non-starchy veg, no rice/pasta/potato.
ingredients: 4 boneless pork chops (1/2-inch thick, about 150g each)
why: Chop lane, low-carb winner squarely in band (520 cal / 45g protein / 3g net carbs). Pan-seared chops in a spinach-parmesan cream sauce - meat + fat + non-starchy veg, no starch base, batch-scalable in a skillet with weigh-and-divide. Distinct protein from the run's already-accepted creamy-tuscan-chicken. Board covers pork-chops, heavy-cream, chicken-broth, parmesan, olive-oil, butter, garlic, italian-seasoning, spinach; only sun-dried tomato lacks a board home (flagged for pricer lane).
